title: Medical office dispensing controlled substances, new business — Carolina (autonomous), urban zone X
description: We are opening a pain-management clinic in a leased office in Carolina. Our physicians will store and dispense controlled medications on site.

mustInclude.rationale: RULE_0002 municipality baseline: every business gets the IRS EIN. (KB: RULE_0002, RULE_0620)
RULE_0003 municipality baseline: Registro de Comerciante (SURI). (KB: RULE_0003)
RULE_0651: new LLC -> Certificate of Organization (Departamento de Estado). (KB: RULE_0651)
RULE_0004 municipality baseline: Patente Municipal (Ley 107-2020 Codigo Municipal). (KB: RULE_0004)
RULE_0007: a physical commercial premises (Q_PHYSICAL_LOCATION) -> Permiso Unico (Ley 161-2009). (KB: RULE_0007)
Storing / dispensing controlled substances needs the Departamento de Salud registration (Ley 4-1971 Arts. 302-304), not only in pharmacies. (KB: RULE_0733)
Practitioners who dispense controlled substances register with the DEA per location (21 CFR 1301.11). (KB: RULE_0734)

mustNotInclude.rationale: Not a cannabis dispensary: RULE_0735 is keyed to the dispensary business type.
No renewable installation: RULE_0610 needs Q_RENEWABLE_INSTALL=true.
No renewable installation: RULE_0611 needs Q_RENEWABLE_INSTALL=true.
No microgrid stated: PT_MICROGRID needs microgrid_configuration=true.

notes: Added 2026-10-04 (KB gaps): the controlled-substances registrations are question-driven, so they reach any business that dispenses controlled substances, not only pharmacies.
